channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, AI, Tech & Research, Africa, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, AI, Tech & Research, Africa, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research grant - week of 08 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Cambridge-Africa: ALBORADA Research Fund 2026
    https://www.cambridge-africa.cam.ac.uk/initiatives/2026-call-for-applications
    Cambridge-Africa Programme, University of Cambridge (supported by The ALBORADA Trust) · deadline Closed 03 Sep 2026 · Competitive grants of GBP 1,000 to 25,000. Covers research costs such as reagents, fieldwork, equipment and research-training activities in Africa (e.g. setting up courses/workshops). No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
